notes: Starter impact (mw-e29.3): the generic puff of dust and grit when a blow or a knocked object strikes something without a more specific effect (style bible §8: alpha-blended, environment palette). Spawned by the VFX cue sheets' generic DamageApplied, physicsImpact and arrowImpact rules, oriented to the hit normal; material-specific impacts (splinters, bone dust) come with mw-e29.4.
